headword: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A vehicle powered by an electric motor using energy stored in rechargeable batteries, as opposed to a conventional internal combustion engine vehicle.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}に{乗|の}り{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I switched to an electric car.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{充電|じゅうでん}スタンドが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Charging stations for electric vehicles are increasing.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}への{意識|いしき}が{高|たか}まり、{電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{販売台数|はんばいだいすう}が{年々|ねんねん}{伸|の}びている。
examples.english: As environmental awareness has grown, electric vehicle sales have been increasing year by year.

notes:
Composed of {電気|でんき} (electricity) and {自動車|じどうしゃ} (automobile). Often abbreviated as EV in both Japanese and English contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{充電|じゅうでん} (EV charging)
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{普及|ふきゅう} (spread of electric vehicles)
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}に{買|か}い{替|か}える (to replace one's car with an EV)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}: battery electric vehicle (fully electric)
- ハイブリッド{車|しゃ}: hybrid vehicle (combined electric and gasoline)
- {燃料|ねんりょう}{電池|でんち}{車|しゃ}: fuel cell vehicle (hydrogen-powered)
